text: 2026-09-22: the blocking condition was crossed without incident. codec/recall.scala:140 exports recall text and M1/StoryAtlas render it, on redistributable data only. The exit is re-anchored on the public workflow: before bd-01M35B103S2KHRSF853GD2FYHW publishes a recall inventory, the publish path requires a typed recall-text disclosure basis (e.g. PublicCorpusAdmitted(record) | CertifiedPseudonymized(witness) | LocalOnly), derived from the input path and never a caller string. Otherwise it refuses to write recall text. Court: pseudonymized input -> segmented -> exported keeps its witness; raw private input refuses publication; public Sherlock transcripts pass through their admission record. Add a blocking edge to bd-01M35B103S2KHRSF853GD2FYHW only if that workflow will run on non-public recall.
